title: AI safety needs rules and power, and Australia should be securing both
headline: Australia urged to act on AI safety regulation
summary: Researchers and policymakers have advised that Australia should take immediate action regarding AI safety. The consensus is that the nation must act now to maintain influence over the development of AI governance.
why_it_matters: Australian organisations and policymakers are encouraged to prioritise proactive engagement in AI safety frameworks to ensure national influence in the global regulatory landscape.

quotes.text: We spent a week asking AI researchers and policymakers what Australia should do about it.
Their message was blunt: act now while we still have some say.

classification.significance_reason: Highlights the strategic urgency for Australia to establish a clear regulatory position on AI safety.
